items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 8 November 2026 4:05am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 08 November 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over eastern Europe as a shallow area of low pressure and associated weak frontal zone affects the British Isles.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, becoming east or southeast 3 or 4 overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers becoming isolated later. Areas of mist and fog in the far southeast of the area soon clearing.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers. Poor or very poor in mist and fog.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 through the morning, occasionally 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, soon building slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.
